state_taxonomy.source: proposed independently by one of three external model analyses the owner pasted into this session; adopted here because it directly operationalizes the owner's original ask ('علت وجود هرکدوم و آیا واقعاً توی تلگرام اعمال شده')

values.METAPHOR_ONLY: described in a vault doc or spec; no corresponding code found
values.IMPLEMENTED_NOT_WIRED: code exists, tested in isolation, but nothing on the live call path invokes it
values.SHADOW_ONLY: code exists and IS invoked, but only behind a default-off flag or in a shadow/dry-run mode that never touches production state
values.LIVE_UNVERIFIED: code is on the live call path and fixture-tested, but no live/soak evidence proves it behaves correctly under real Telegram traffic
values.OPERATIONAL_VERIFIED: on the live call path, fixture-tested, AND has live evidence (a real run, a real restart, a real reconciled receipt)
values.UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE: artifact exists but this pass found no reference to it anywhere in the code/test/vault graph that would explain its purpose or owner
